title: Harrowfield's ambient description of the post-bargain food shortage never updates after the shortage is explicitly, permanently resolved. The green shows 'bread watched closer, since the bargain' both before and after I paid 10 gold to Sten to keep the field fallow, even though Sten's own dialogue confirms it is settled for good ('so the bargain never has to be asked twice... doesn't touch the furlong-map again all spring').
where: Harrowfield — the Green (room description), after 'The Shieldings, After' quest completes

evidence.quote: Harrowfield's ambient description of the post-bargain food shortage never updates after the shortage is explicitly, permanently resolved. The green shows 'bread watched closer, since the bargain' both before and after I paid 10 gold to Sten to keep the field fallow, even though Sten's own dialogue confirms it is settled for good ('so the bargain never has to be asked twice... doesn't touch the furlong-map again all spring').

Sten's field-reeve farewell line ('Mind the blank strip on your way past') never updates even though the room's own short description updates twice (to 'more furlongs inked out now') and Sten's dialogue confirms the strip is permanently inked in, not blank, after the bargain.
